concept: Secrets Manager: automatic rotation of DB credentials
tests: Choosing a secrets store with automatic DB password rotation every 30 days.
expected: AWS Secrets Manager with rotation enabled: native RDS integration via a managed rotation Lambda. Triggers: "rotate automatically", "every 30 days", "database credentials", RDS.
why_not: Parameter Store (standard) doesn't rotate automatically; S3 and KMS (stores keys, not secrets) don't fit.
